scenario.user: There was a break-in at my place on the night of June 19 to 20, 2026. I found it at 8 am on June 20. The TV and the gaming chair were taken from the basement. Prepare my contents claim.

answers.answer: The assistant is on the local model. Go on.
Leave the exhibits where they are and record their SHA-256.

answers.match: untouched|last time|language|insurer|claim number|how.*say what was lost
answers.answer: The place was last known untouched at 22:00 on 2026-06-19, and I found the loss at 08:00 on 2026-06-20. Kind: theft. Room: basement. I typed what was lost: the TV and the gaming chair. English. No insurer name or claim number. Yes, include the back door camera.

answers.match: confirm|which of these|were lost|correct|anything to (add|change)|replacement value|rows?
answers.answer: Only the TV and the gaming chair were taken. Nothing else was lost. The TV is worth 700 CAD and the gaming chair 300 CAD. The rows are right.
